describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile against a plain off-white background, standing on four short limbs. It has an elongated, tapered snout with a dark nostril at the tip and fine whiskers around the muzzle, a small dark eye, and a long thick tail that extends to the left beyond the frame. The dorsal and lateral surfaces of the body, tail, top of the head, and upper limbs are covered in overlapping rounded brown scales with darker centers and tan edges, interspersed with irregular patches of pale pinkish-white scales. The ventral surfaces, lower limbs, and face are covered in wrinkled, sparsely haired skin. Six bright pink, fleshy, feathery stalks with fine filamentous frills protrude from the neck and head region. The animal casts a soft shadow on the ground beneath its feet.

describe.description: A quadrupedal scaly creature shown in right-side profile walking to the right on a plain background. Its body is arched and covered in large overlapping rounded brown scales with scattered patches of larger pale pink speckled scales on the flank and shoulder. The head is elongated to a blunt pointed snout with a dark nostril at the tip, a small round black eye, fine whiskers, and wrinkled tan-brown skin on the face. Behind the eye and on top of the head are six pink fleshy stalks tipped with dense red feathery filaments. It has four short thick legs with wrinkled skin and broad clawed feet, and a long thick tapering scaly tail extending to the left and cropped by the edge of the image.
